Concrete Calculator

Calculate cubic yards of concrete for any slab, plus how many 60 lb or 80 lb bags that equals.

Enter slab dimensions to calculate.

Volume = L × W × (thickness ÷ 12) cubic feet ÷ 27. Bag counts include 10% waste.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the slab length and width in feet.
  2. Enter the thickness in inches (4 is standard for patios).
  3. Read the cubic yards to order and the equivalent bag count.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is cubic yardage calculated?

Volume in cubic feet (length × width × thickness in feet) divided by 27. One cubic yard = 27 cubic feet.

How much does an 80 lb bag of concrete make?

About 0.6 cubic feet of mixed concrete. A 60 lb bag makes about 0.45 cubic feet.

Should I add extra for waste?

Yes. The bag counts include a 10% waste allowance; for ready-mix, order the rounded-up yardage shown.
